title: Senior Manager (Corporate Communications & PR)
description:
Job description


Senior Manager (Corporate Communications & PR)
 
Your role in summary
The Senior Manager is a pivotal role within our team, responsible for developing and executing communication strategies and action plans. In this capacity, you will act as the principal point of contact for our clients, ensuring their satisfaction and retention through dedicated service and the application of V+O principles and values. This role requires close collaboration with the Director/ Business Unit Director, and involves a strong focus on client advisory, especially in areas of corporate communications, public affairs, policy research and analysis.
Key Responsibilities:

Develop and manage corporate communication strategies and action plans under the direction of the Director/ Business Unit Director.
Advise clients on public affairs and stakeholder engagement in coordination with the Director/ Business Unit Director.
Build, manage, and nurture existing client relationships, ensuring continual deepening of these relationships through client satisfaction, development, and retention.
Serve as the project owner for the portfolio, maintaining client KPIs and reports, and proposing actionable recommendations based on outcomes.
Proactively anticipate client needs and provide relevant, timely recommendations.
Responsible for creating all copywriting materials (Press Releases, Q&A documents, interviews, speeches) in line with agreed strategy.
Build and maintain strong relationships and networks with the media and other stakeholders per client needs.
Oversee client’s press office activities under the supervision of Director/ Business Unit Director.
Organize and ensure the timely, budget-compliant completion of all project deliverables.
Support crisis communications under the supervision of Director/ Business Unit Director.
Conduct research on policy issues at national, European, and international levels, and monitor legislation and regulations relevant to client’s business interests.
Undertake the people manager role, managing, training, guiding, and developing team members in accordance with company values and management processes.
Cooperate with external providers, ensuring performance and compliance with company policies.
Manage the completion of all client-related administrative tasks (databases, ISO files, etc.) on time and in accordance with company policies and procedures.

QUALIFICATIONS AND STANDARDS: 
Education & Experience 
 
Essential
- University degree in Business Administration, Media Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or Political Science
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Greek and English
- Minimum 5 years of relevant working experience in a PR firm or in a Corporate Communication Department
Desirable 
- A master's or advanced degree in a relevant field, demonstrating a higher level of expertise.
- Advanced experience in crisis communications
Join us for a challenging career! 
We offer an exciting business framework for you to accelerate professionally as well as a competitive remuneration package and benefits both numerical and non-numerical. We work with great clients, from SMB to global corporations, on a variety of communication challenges, to create compelling and persuasive experiences through insightful planning, innovative thinking, and seamless execution.
If you want to become a member of our team, please send us your CV at careers@vando.gr 
 
Your application will be handled with the utmost confidentiality!

title: Payments Risk Operations Specialist
description: Etraveli Group is the globally leading company for tech solutions and fulfillment capabilities for online sales of flights. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond. We hold consumer online travel agency brands like Mytrip, GoToGate & Flight Network and serve Booking.com with flights. Etraveli Group has also established strategic partnerships with companies like Skyscanner, Google Flights, TUI, etc. Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 2400 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do. Our major offices are in Sweden (HQ), Canada, Greece, India, Poland with the Athens office being one of the largest, hosting around 580 employees working from the center of Athens for the rest of the world. Join us and start as Payments Risk Operations Specialist in the Risk Management team!Position SummaryIf you are captivated by mind games, you possess strong investigation skills and can see patterns behind numbers and scattered pieces of information, it’s highly likely that Payments Risk Operations Specialist would be your dream job!As a Payments Risk Operations Specialist your main responsibility will be to protect Etraveli Group from financial losses due to fraudulent activities while maintaining sales and customer experience in top performance. Besides screening high risk transactions, this role should also propose innovative improvements in existing processes. The ideal candidate must have excellent investigation, problem solving and decision making skills and is expected to be up-to-date with the latest online fraud trends as well as with potential fraud screening tools.Responsibilities Screen potentially high-risk transactions accurately and in a timely manner utilizing a wide range of fraud prevention systems, tools and reports. Identify fraud patterns or abnormalities and take appropriate actions to prevent similar activities and mitigate potential future fraud. Thoroughly process and analyze fraud alerts received from external sources. Ensure transaction authenticity by contacting customers via phone and/or email. Propose innovative improvements to our existing processes, aiming to further enhance our fraud prevention and detection strategies Deliver dynamic tasks & provide support for a wide range of business analyses. Stay up to date with the latest online fraud trends, practices, and tools through continuous learning & research. Be a problem-solver. Requirements Bachelor’s degree and/or studies preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics. Excellent command of the English language. Advanced experience with MS office (especially Excel) Data driven approach along with strong critical, analytical and investigation skills. Ability to act proactively, take initiatives and demonstrate a can-do attitude focusing on producing high quality results within a fast-paced environment. Team player with strong interpersonal and communication skills including the ability to effectively interact with clients.  Work independently, meet tight deadlines while navigating multiple systems and processes Discretion in dealing with confidential information. High level of responsibility & integrity combined with eagerness to work in a multicultural, international environment subject to continuous changes. Previous work experience as a Fraud Analyst will be considered a plus  Availability to work on shifts around the clock (24/7) – 8-hour shifts, 5 days per week including weekends and bank holidays. title: Sales Advisor (Nea Erythraia) / Εκπρόσωπος Πωλήσεων (Νέα Ερυθραία)
description:
About us
In 2023, FOURLIS Group entered into the fast growing sector of health and wellness with Holland & Barrett! So far, we count 10 physical retail stores operating in Attiki and Thessaloniki!
Our vision is to become a leading player in the health & wellness industry throughout the region of Greece, Romania and Bulgaria by opening 120 physical stores over time along with our Holland & Barrett e-shop!
Holland & Barrett International, established in 1870, is one of the Europe’s leading health and wellness retailers in providing a wide range of products in 4 key pillars - vitamins & supplements, natural beauty, health foods, and sports nutrition - with over 1.600 stores worldwide!
Do you want to become part of our health & wellness success story? If yes, then this is the right time to apply for the Sales Advisor position (full-time) for our shop-in-shop in Nea Erythraia (Attiki)!
Wellness begins with you, start your journey today!
 
The job
Sales Advisors are vital to our success! Yes, you will need to be able to carry out regular tasks for the optimal store operation like delivering exceptional customer service, making sales, replenishing shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy, but there's so much more to it than that! Sales Advisors are experts in giving our customers the advice they need to live healthier, happier lives. And you will be ready for whatever question, query or lifestyle goal is thrown your way, as we make sure you complete a specialized “Qualified to Advise” training that is designed in order for you to thrive in your role! The training is challenging, but it will turn you into a health and wellness expert, ready to advise our customers on whatever they need! If you want to go on and specialize in sports, nutrition, beauty or aromatherapy, we can help you to do that too.
 
The person
To be successful, we'd like you to show us that you have:

Passion and enthusiasm for our products, nutritional supplements, natural beauty and healthy living
Compassionate and consultative approach to customers
Motivation to study and ability to undertake computer-based study to support the product knowledge required to achieve an accredited qualification
Ability to work well within a team
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to effectively multi-task
Positive attitude and achievement drive
At least one (1) year of experience in sales/customer service
Good knowledge of the English language, both written and verbal
PC skills
Fulfilled military obligations (where applicable)

Considered as an asset:

Bachelor's Degree in Nutrition & Dietetic Science studies or Pharmacy studies or related field

 
We offer
We offer a competitive remuneration & benefits package (bonus scheme, medical plan, etc.), extensive and continuous training, as well as exceptional opportunities to grow and develop both personally and professionally in an exciting and empowering work environment!
If you want to join our team, please send us your complete resume!
